correctness.rationale: Exact four-cycle criterion and a C_p-equivariant p-ball cover of a cross-polytope sphere prove a literal orbit-space mapping cone. The reduced real regular representation splits into Fourier weight lines and has free unit-sphere action for odd prime p; suspended lens CW differentials and a degree-p top attachment give Z/p in exactly the indicated even degrees. Simply connectivity follows from suspending a connected lens space. The packaged finite checker independently verifies the forest criterion and the integer boundary compositions of the orbit boundary complex for p=3,5; no extrapolation from finite experiments is used.

value.rationale: A canonical prime cyclic action on the graphic matroid complex of K_{2,p} creates p-primary torsion in (p-1)/2 positive homological degrees, unbounded as p grows, from a simply connected torsion-free wedge of spheres. The exact weighted lens-cover mapping cone is a structural orbit-space classification beyond representation characters and rational Betti numbers.
